summary: OpenCode made GLM 5.3 Flash free on 2026-10-16. OpenCode's Console docs list GLM-5.3-Flash Free (model id glm-5.3-flash-free) with free input, output and cached reads for a limited time, on the https://opencode.ai/inference/openai/v1/chat/completions endpoint. The Inference API docs permit free chat calls without an Authorization header, providing an account-optional direct API route. Optional Console/TUI setup separately asks for billing details and credits; this is not a Console funding waiver. No inference request was tested. No end date is stated. Per OpenCode's docs, its provider follows a zero-retention policy and does not use your data for model training. The paid GLM 5.3 Flash model (glm-5.3-flash) is listed separately at $0.15/$0.50 per 1M input/output tokens, so pick the Free variant.
claim_steps: For the documented account-optional route, POST JSON to https://opencode.ai/inference/openai/v1/chat/completions with model glm-5.3-flash-free and messages, omitting the Authorization header. No inference request was tested.
Alternatively, sign in to OpenCode Console and copy your API key. General Console setup asks for billing details and credits; the direct free-chat exception is not a Console funding waiver.
In the OpenCode TUI, run /connect, choose the OpenCode pay-as-you-go provider, and paste your API key.
Run /models and select GLM-5.3-Flash Free (opencode/glm-5.3-flash-free), not the paid GLM 5.3 Flash.
The free period is limited-time; use the exact -free model ID rather than the separately priced paid variant.
